description: Scholarship schemes for students in India, with eligibility, commonly required documents, application-period guidance and official portals.
application_deadline_disclaimer: Application dates can change and eligibility depends on current official scheme rules. Verify live deadlines and guidelines before applying.

scholarships.name: PM-USP Central Sector Scheme of Scholarship for College and University Students (CSSS)
scholarships.eligibility: Eligible meritorious students entering a regular recognised degree, meeting Class XII board-performance and family-income conditions; fresh and renewal rules differ.
commonly_required_documents: Identity proof and OTR where required
scholarships.2026_27_application_period: Renewal applications currently listed through 31 October 2026; check whether fresh applications are open for your case.

scholarships.name: AICTE Pragati Scholarship
scholarships.eligibility: Eligible girl students admitted to AICTE-approved technical diploma or degree programmes, subject to current scheme conditions.
commonly_required_documents: Identity proof and OTR where required
scholarships.2026_27_application_period: NSP lists applications from 1 June to 31 October 2026; verify live scheme entry and institute-verification deadlines.

scholarships.name: AICTE Saksham Scholarship
scholarships.eligibility: Eligible students with benchmark disabilities enrolled in AICTE-approved technical diploma or degree programmes, subject to current rules.
commonly_required_documents: Disability certificate or UDID if required
Identity proof and OTR where required
scholarships.2026_27_application_period: NSP lists applications from 1 June to 31 October 2026; verify the current entry.

scholarships.name: AICTE Swanath Scholarship
scholarships.eligibility: Eligible students in approved technical programmes who meet scheme-defined circumstances, such as specified orphan or parent-death categories.
commonly_required_documents: Identity proof and OTR where required
scholarships.2026_27_application_period: NSP lists applications from 1 June to 31 October 2026; verify exact category and deadline.

scholarships.name: Top Class Education for SC Students
scholarships.eligibility: Eligible SC students in prescribed full-time courses at institutions on the notified list, subject to current income and other conditions.
commonly_required_documents: Identity proof and OTR where required
scholarships.2026_27_application_period: NSP currently lists 31 October 2026 as closing date; confirm scheme entry and eligible institution.

scholarships.name: Post-Matric Scholarship for SC/ST/OBC Students
scholarships.eligibility: Eligible students in post-matric education under the relevant state or central scheme, meeting category, income, domicile and course conditions.
commonly_required_documents: Domicile or hostel proof if required
scholarships.2026_27_application_period: State and category deadlines vary. Chhattisgarh applicants should check the current state notification and portal.

scholarships.name: PM YASASVI Post-Matric Scholarship for OBC, EBC and DNT Students
scholarships.eligibility: Eligible students meeting current category, income, course and state or portal rules.
commonly_required_documents: Identity proof and OTR where required
scholarships.2026_27_application_period: Do not assume one national deadline; check the live NSP and state listing.

scholarships.name: National Fellowship and Scholarship for Higher Education of ST Students
scholarships.eligibility: Eligible ST students under the relevant higher-education scholarship or research-fellowship component.
commonly_required_documents: Identity proof and OTR where required
scholarships.2026_27_application_period: Check the current Ministry or NSP notice; fellowship and scholarship components may have different schedules.

common_document_checklist: Identity proof or Aadhaar where accepted and NSP OTR where required
Current admission letter or bonafide certificate
Category or caste certificate where applicable
Disability certificate or UDID where applicable
Fee receipt or fee structure if requested
Proof of special eligible circumstance where applicable
